name: Azure Functions Consumption Free Grant
free_limit: 1 million executions and 400,000 GB-seconds of resource consumption per month per subscription on the Consumption plan.
watch_out: Free grant applies only to paid Consumption subscriptions. The required storage account, network usage, monitoring and other Azure resources can be billed separately. Over-quota use is billed; a payment card is normally required at Azure signup. Linux Consumption hosting retires September 2028.
